name: Juri
source:
The last Hakkenshi to appear, who was one of the four head executives in Gotou Faction.
[spoiler]Her full name is Ebado Juri. She is Mondo's older sister. Before joining Gotou Faction, she was the leader of the 4th Unit from Son Faction.
She is considered the second strongest Hakkenshi in terms of combat, only after Gotou, although Gotou admits that she could still defeat him in a no rules fight.[/spoiler]
